title: PROOF THAT UCC 1-308 PROTECTS YOUR SIGNATURE
summary: Promoter presents an insurer's refusal of a UCC 1-308 signature as proof the reservation of rights protects signers.

assertions.quote: how ucc 1-308 protects your signature when you're signing your lives away
this right here goes in my book my book of proofs and validation

verdicts.note: A company declining altered contract terms shows only caution about its arbitration clause, not that the notation exempts anyone from law.

assertions.quote: is not legal if it's not mutual if it's not a mutual understanding within the contract

verdicts.note: Courts enforce signed standard-form contracts whether or not the signer read or understood every term.
